name: Christopher Redard
intro: Mechanical design, mechanisms, and hardware prototypes, from first sketch in CAD to a part on the bench. Spin the models, read the build notes, or order a print.
about:
I'm an engineer who likes to work with my hands. Most of my projects start as a problem at the bench, turn into a model in OnShape or SolidWorks, and end up printed, wired, or machined.

This site collects the projects I've worked on over the years. Some are finished, some are ongoing, and a few taught me more by failing.

skills.items: Mechanism kinematics, force and torque analysis, FEA
Raspberry Pi, Arduino, sensors, pneumatics, connectors
FDM 3D printing (Bambu Lab X2D), fastening and tapping
